hint: Each assistant has its own chats, inbox and computers, and runs wherever you choose.
unsupported: This hub's version doesn't support assistants yet. Update the hub and come back.
delete_builtin: The assistant the hub runs itself can't be deleted
delete_default: The default assistant can't be deleted. Make another one the default first
err_default: This is the default assistant. Make another one the default before deleting it
err_builtin: The hub runs this assistant itself. It can't be deleted or installed elsewhere
err_gone: This assistant is no longer there
err_installing: It isn't installed yet. Rename it or make it the default once it is
err_forbidden: This device isn't allowed to make changes
name: Name
move_confirm: Installing elsewhere gives you a new install code. Once it's installed with that code, the assistant where it ran before stops working right away.
delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? Its token stops working right away and its connections are closed.
cancel_install_confirm: Cancel installing “{name}”? Its install code will stop working.
new_hint: You get an install code. Install it on the computer that will run it within 10 minutes.
commands_note: Run one of these on the computer that will run it. Once installed, it shows up in the list. The code works once.
code_note: Install the assistant with this code on the computer that will run it. Once installed, it shows up in the list.
bot_conflict_feishu: {names} use the same Lark bot app ID.
bot_conflicts_hint: Based on each assistant's last reported settings, including offline assistants. Messages may reach a different assistant, or connections may interrupt each other. Configure a separate bot or WeChat account for each assistant.
push_note: When off, this device gets no notifications from this assistant
offline_body: {name} is offline. You can read the history, but can't send messages for now.
offline_page_body: Last synced {time}. This updates when it's back online.
offline_page_body_never: This updates when it's back online.
delete_machines_one: Its {count} computer goes back to the hub's own assistant.
delete_machines_other: Its {count} computers go back to the hub's own assistant.
delete_sources: Its sources (mail accounts, for example) are kept in its own database: unless you move them to another assistant first, they are deleted with it.
needs_update_note: Its personad is older and doesn't read settings of its own (manager.json) yet, so it runs on built-in defaults. Update personad on the computer it runs on.
machine_offline: Its assistant “{name}” is offline. It comes back online once the assistant is back.
